data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this stunning 3-bedroom apartment for rent in Creek Rise Tower 1.

Property Features:
• 3 Bedrooms
• 3 Bathrooms
• Size: 1,664 sqft
• 2 Covered Parking Spaces
• Maid’s Room
• Laundry Room
• Unfurnished
• Vacant from June
• Mid-floor unit
• Chiller Free
• Creek and Community Views
• Asking Price: AED 185,000 in 3 Cheques

This spacious apartment offers a bright and functional layout with modern finishes and large windows that allow natural light throughout the living and dining areas. The open-plan design creates a comfortable living environment ideal for families.

All bedrooms are generously sized with built-in wardrobes, while the master bedroom includes an en-suite bathroom. The maid’s room and dedicated laundry area add extra convenience and practicality to the home.

Located in the heart of Dubai Creek Harbour, residents enjoy a premium waterfront lifestyle with access to retail outlets, dining options, landscaped walkways, and excellent community amenities.

For more information or to arrange a viewing, contact us today.
